jobs.description:
Business Developer – International Markets
About Sigster Pictures AB
Sigster Pictures AB is a Stockholm-based consulting and creative company working across
business development, strategy, branding, film, design and product development.
We help businesses identify opportunities, develop new concepts and turn ideas into
commercially viable projects. By connecting international clients with Swedish expertise, we
support business growth, creative development and access to new markets.
The Role
Sigster Pictures AB is looking for an experienced Business Developer to expand its
international business, initially focusing on Asian markets and gradually developing
opportunities in other regions.
You will identify new clients, build business relationships and translate client needs into
consulting and business-development opportunities. Working closely with Sigster Pictures
AB, you will help clients understand how our expertise can support their business objectives
and turn opportunities into concrete projects.
We are particularly interested in candidates who combine commercial experience with an
understanding of creative industries, such as fashion, graphic design, film, branding, product
development, retail or related fields. You may have started your career in a creative or
product-focused role and subsequently moved into business development, consulting or client
management.
Key Responsibilities
 Identify and develop new clients, initially focusing on Asian markets.
 Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing clients and
international partners.
 Understand client needs and identify relevant consulting, creative and product-
development opportunities.
 Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial offers.
 Support client discussions and negotiations through to agreed engagements.
 Connect clients with relevant Swedish and Scandinavian expertise.
 Support projects from initial concept through development, coordinating with clients
and relevant partners as needed.
 Maintain a clear pipeline of business opportunities and report on business-
development progress.
About You
You are commercially minded, proactive and comfortable working across cultures. You
understand both the creative and commercial sides of a business and recognise how ideas,
products and services can create value for clients.A university degree or bachelor's-level qualification is required, preferably in business,
design, creative industries, marketing, communications, product development or a related
field.
We are looking for someone with:
 Experience in business development, client development, consulting or a related
commercial role.
 An understanding of one or more creative industries, such as fashion, graphic design,
film, branding, product development, retail or other design-led businesses.
 The ability to identify opportunities, develop proposals and build lasting client
relationships.
 Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
 An understanding of how ideas, products and services move from concept to
commercial execution.
 Excellent written and spoken English.
 Strong organisational and project-management skills.
 An entrepreneurial, opportunity-oriented mindset.
 A willingness to travel internationally when required.
A background in a creative discipline or industry is welcome, particularly when combined
with commercial experience. Relevant professional experience and demonstrated ability are
highly valued alongside formal education.
International & Asian Markets
The role will initially focus on Asian markets, with opportunities to expand into other
regions. Experience working with markets such as China, India, Southeast Asia or other
international markets is an advantage.
Knowledge of international business environments, supply chains, product development or
creative industries is also valuable. We welcome candidates with diverse international
backgrounds and professional experience.
What We Offer
At Sigster Pictures AB, you will work in a growing company where international business
development, consulting and creative expertise come together.
The role offers the opportunity to:
 Help develop Sigster Pictures AB ‘s international business and client base.
 Work directly with international clients and partners.
 Build relationships across European and Asian markets.
 Develop commercial opportunities across consulting, branding, film, design and
product development.
 Take responsibility for building new business relationships and developing
opportunities into projects.
 Work in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment based in Stockholm.How to Apply
Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience,
international business exposure and interest in the role.
Employment: Permanent, full-time
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Working language: English
Travel: International travel may be required depending on client and project requirements.

Join an AI-driven Tech Company and help build a modern finance function? Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Perhaps you have built a strong foundation at an accounting firm or in an in-house finance team, and are now looking for a more dynamic environment where you can take greater ownership, make a real impact, and help shape how things are done. 
Tendium is looking for an experienced Accountant to join the team.  
The Finance team owns the numbers at Tendium. We are building the finance function of tomorrow, where AI and automation handle repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on work that requires your expertise and judgment. You will not only work within existing structures but also help shape them by documenting procedures, improving workflows, and building scalable processes as we grow.
About Tendium
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
The Role
This is a hands-on role with broad responsibility. You'll work closely with the CFO and take ownership of important parts of our day-to-day accounting while helping us develop scalable processes as we grow. Your responsibilities will include:

Monthly Closing & Reconciliations: Independently perform monthly closings, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, and VAT reporting across multiple group entities.

Revenue Recognition: Manage revenue reconciliations and deferrals related to customer contracts and subscription invoicing.

Accounts Receivable: Own invoicing, customer payments, reminders, and collections.

Day-to-Day Accounting: Handle bookkeeping, supplier invoices, payments, expenses, payroll support, and intercompany transactions.

Year-End Closing & Audit: Support year-end closings, annual reports, and audits together with the CFO.

Systems & Improvements: Improve and document accounting routines, develop workflows, and explore how automation and AI can make our finance processes more efficient.

Who you are
We value ambition, ownership, and the right mindset as much as experience.

Independent & Proactive: You take ownership of your work, drive tasks to completion autonomously, and proactively identify challenges, find solutions, and seek support when needed.

Attention to Detail: Your reconciliations are accurate, and you investigate discrepancies until you fully understand them and can clearly explain their causes.

Adaptable & Growth Mindset: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, challenges evolve, and not everything is figured out yet. You're eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated by the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Curious & Tech-Savvy: You're curious about new technologies and eager to explore how AI and automation can improve financial processes. You have strong systems proficiency, understand API integrations, and continuously look for smarter, more efficient ways of working.

Process Builder: You are comfortable working without established procedures and understand how to create scalable processes by collaborating with other system owners and specialists.

Fluent in English, proficient in Swedish

Your experience
3–6 years of relevant accounting experience, ideally from a Swedish accounting firm (redovisningsbyrå) or a similar role in-house with broad accounting responsibilities.

Solid practical experience with Swedish bookkeeping, VAT, reconciliations, and monthly closings.

Experience independently managing accounting for one or several Swedish companies, from day-to-day transactions through monthly closing.

Comfortable working directly in accounting systems and handling  accounting tasks.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Nice to have:

Experience with Fortnox.

Experience preparing year-end accounts and annual reports.

Experience with SaaS, subscription billing, or revenue deferrals.

Experience improving accounting processes or implementing automation.

Application
Excited to join us? Apply today! We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to getting to know you. Please note that we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship or work permit support for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.

 Equality and Inclusion
At Tendium, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone feels included, heard, and valued. We believe different perspectives drive innovation and welcome people from all backgrounds to help shape the future together.

jobs.employer_name: Who Collaborating Centre For Int Drug Monitoring
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to safer use of medicines and vaccines globally? We are looking for a Data Scientist for the Research Department at Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC). You will join a multicultural and dynamic environment with a clear focus to ensure patient safety globally.
Since 1978, Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) has been dedicated to developing, supporting, and expanding the field of pharmacovigilance science and practice.
As a World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre, we support work around the world to examine the potential adverse effects of medicines and vaccines and contribute to safer, more informed care of patients.
We are a diverse, international group of pharmacists, physicians, data scientists, system developers, communicators, and many other professionals motivated by a deep belief that the work we do matters.
About the role
Research at UMC is a team effort. Pharmacovigilance experts, engineers, and data scientists work side by side to develop the best ideas and solutions. We are looking for a Data Scientist with excellent technical skills who thrives on collaboration. You will join a self-organising agile team where members share ideas openly, plan their work together, give each other honest feedback, and take joint ownership of outcomes.
You will report to our Head of Data Science, Angnis Schmidt-May.
What you will do 
You will help us make better use of data from different sources, the main one being our global database of adverse event reports. Your work will mostly cover the following areas:
Machine learning, natural language processing & large language models: develop methods to support signal management using data from case reports and scientific literature. You will judge carefully when and how AI can be trusted to enhance our research.
Scientific research and dissemination: design and run studies in internal and external collaborations, publish in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences.
Sharing methods and assets: make our methods and tools available to others, for example as open-source packages, documented workflows, and reusable models.
Product research: develop innovative methods and conduct exploratory research to improve UMC's products and services. You will work closely with product teams to turn research ideas into useful product features.

Who you are
You are an excellent collaborator. You listen to others and build on their ideas. You share credit and lift the people around you.
You are curious and eager to grow. You seek feedback, reflect on it and act on it. You see learning and development as a lifelong part of your career.
You care about the purpose. Patient safety matters to you, and you hold yourself to high standards of scientific integrity. 

Must have
PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., statistics, computer science, computational linguistics, epidemiology, physics), or a master's degree and PhD-equivalent research experience
Track record of scientific work, such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations
Minimum of 5 years of practical experience in data science (from industry or research)
Strong Python/R skills
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have
Knowledge of
best practices in software engineering
pharmacovigilance, medical terminologies (e.g., MedDRA) or experience working with health data

Experience
working on open-source code
working with cloud infrastructure
working with GenAI and agentic workflows
taking models and methods from research into production
working with user research and product development
mentoring or supervising others

Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) is an independent, self-funded, non-profit foundation established in 1978 dedicated to safer use of medicines and vaccines. Through an agreement between the Government of Sweden and the World Health Organization (WHO), UMC operates the Programme for International Drug Monitoring, supporting over 180 member countries and regions in strengthening safety surveillance, and maintains VigiBase, the WHO global database of adverse event reports. In addition, UMC provides international standards and related digital solutions for secure exchange of pharmacovigilance data, including a global medicine and vaccine terminology for identification of medicinal products. With around 200 staff, UMC advances the science of pharmacovigilance and transforms its practice through technological innovation.

UMC’s working language is English. We normally apply a probationary period to new appointments.
If you have any questions regarding this position please contact the responsible manager. You will find the contact details at the end of this page.
UMC follows the collective agreements between the Swedish Agency for Government Employers and Saco-S and ST. Union representatives are Malin Zaar (Saco-S) and Jessica Avasol (ST), +46 (0)18-65 60 60.

jobs.occupation: Business Team Director E-com to Lindex, Gothenburg
jobs.description:
The opportunity
This is a broad business and channel leadership role with influence over the future of Lindex’s digital commerce. You build an empowered Business Team and balance current sales and delivery with continued development of customer experience, omnichannel growth, operating model and digital capabilities.
You play a key part in shaping a more customer- and market-led international retail business and helping accelerate Lindex’s future growth journey.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced e-commerce leader to accelerate profitable digital and omnichannel growth.
As Business Team Director E-com, you own the digital sales channel and its P&L, spanning site, app, digital trading and merchandising, customer experience, fulfilment, returns and customer service. You connect commercial performance with digital product, technology, data and AI-enabled development to strengthen both today’s business and the next generation of commerce capabilities.
You lead an empowered Business Team together with a Digital Co-Lead, combining business ownership, digital development and continuous improvement. The team is accountable for running, optimising and developing its area, balancing short-term performance with long-term growth and capability development.
The Business Team is supported by Business & Process Developers, analytics capabilities and other functional expertise. The role reports to the Chief Commercial Officer and is part of the Commercial Management team.
Key responsibilities
Own and develop the e-commerce channel, with responsibility for P&L, profitable growth, customer value and commercial performance.
Develop and scale digital customer journeys across discovery, purchase, fulfilment, returns and customer service.
Drive digital trading, merchandising, conversion, personalisation, customer acquisition, loyalty and retention.
Lead omnichannel business development and integrate physical and digital customer experiences.
Translate customer, market and behavioural insights into measurable growth opportunities and business results.
Drive operational excellence within fulfilment, e-commerce operations and customer service.
Prioritise the e-commerce roadmap together with digital product, technology, data and operational leaders.
Evaluate and develop next-generation commerce capabilities, including AI-enabled customer experiences and new digital business opportunities.
Translate Lindex strategy into a clear business plan, priorities, resource allocation and measurable results.
Lead the Business Team through the Run, Optimise and Develop agenda together with the Digital Co-Lead and supporting functions.
Connect commercial priorities with digital development, ensuring that investments and roadmaps create clear customer and business value.
Lead direct reports and functional specialists across reporting lines, developing leaders, capabilities and succession readiness.
Follow up performance, identify deviations and reprioritise when market conditions or business needs change.

About you
You are a commercially grounded e-commerce leader who understands how trading, customer experience, operations, technology and data combine to create profitable growth. You can balance immediate channel performance with long-term capability development and align business, technology and operational priorities in a complex matrix.
To succeed in the role, you need:
Extensive senior leadership experience within e-commerce, digital commerce, omnichannel retail or another customer-facing digital business.
Proven results in profitable digital growth, customer value and commercial performance.
Experience leading digital transformation, omnichannel growth and next-generation commerce capabilities in an international retail or consumer business.
Strong experience developing and scaling digital customer journeys, conversion, personalisation and retention initiatives.
Strong understanding of digital business models, acquisition, loyalty, conversion optimisation and customer lifetime value.
Experience integrating physical and digital customer experiences and leading omnichannel business development.
Strong commercial and analytical capability, including P&L responsibility and translating customer and behavioural insight into measurable results.
Experience working closely with digital product, technology, data and AI-enabled business development.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex matrix organisations and aligning business, technology and operations.
Fluent English and experience from an international environment.
Experience in fashion retail, international e-commerce, digital discovery, fulfilment, customer-service transformation or emerging commerce models is advantageous.

Location and application
The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. English is the working language.
Warmly welcome to submit your application no later than November 22nd via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Maria Hörnestam, +46 76 338 76 46, maria.hornestam@maquire.se
Maquire works with a fair and competency-based recruitment process linked to a clearly defined requirement profile. We do not use AI for screening and selection. Every application is reviewed by a human recruiter.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager (Professional Hygiene) Kiilto in Malmö
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take ownership of one of the market’s most established and well-known brands in professional hygiene? As a Product Manager at Kiilto, you will be the driver behind DAX – steering the portfolio, developing the market and delivering commercial results. You will be part of an engaged Nordic team that takes pride in what they do and genuinely enjoys working together.
We are now looking for a Product Manager to join Kiilto in Malmö!
This is a permanent, full-time position with a preferred start as soon as possible.

What does Kiilto do?
Kiilto is a Finnish, family-owned chemical and chemical technology company founded in 1919 and now in its fourth generation of family leadership. With approximately 700 employees across nine countries, Kiilto develops, manufactures and sells products and solutions across four business areas: Construction, Industrial Adhesives & Fire Protection, Professional Hygiene, and Consumer Products.
As a company with over 100 years of history, Kiilto combines deep expertise with a clear focus on the future, investing in sustainability, innovation and customer impact as the cornerstones of long-term growth.
Learn more at www.kiilto.com
What does a Product Manager do at Kiilto?
As a Product Manager at Kiilto, you take ownership of assigned product lines within Professional Hygiene, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant and commercially successful. You are the voice of the customer and the driver of your portfolio. The role is based in Malmö and forms part of a broader Nordic product management team (Denmark, Finland and Sweden).
Your focus will be on the DAX portfolio and Kiilto Pro range, primarily serving healthcare customers such as hospitals, regions and professional cleaning environments. This is not a passive portfolio management role. We are looking for someone who proactively drives their products forward and takes clear ownership of the result.
Some of your key responsibilities:

Drive Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) for your assigned product lines

Maintain product roadmaps and lifecycle plans – and drive actions to keep products competitive

Identify development, improvement and discontinuation opportunities in collaboration with cross-functional teams

Prepare business cases and strategic recommendations

Monitor product performance, profitability and competitiveness

Gather customer and market insights and translate them into product decisions

Ensure product information, labelling and regulatory compliance are up to date

Support Sales with product expertise, training, tender activities and complex customer cases

Who are you?
We are looking for a commercially driven product manager who takes ownership and is comfortable making decisions in a cross-functional environment. You don't need to come from a traditional product management background – a strong sales background combined with a commercial mindset works equally well.
What matters most is that you are proactive, structured and genuinely curious about your products and your customers. Product Lifecycle Management experience is a must, everything else we can develop together.
Requirements for this role:

Experience in product management or product lifecycle management 

Strong commercial and analytical mindset – ability to assess product performance and drive decisions

Experience of cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

Fluent in Swedish and English – both written and spoken

Comfortable working independently as part of a distributed Nordic team

Experience from a regulated environment (professional hygiene, chemicals, pharma or similar), familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce, or a background close to sales teams is highly advantageous. An interest in sustainability is a plus.
What we offer! 
At Kiilto you get a broad and impactful role in a stable, family-owned company with a long-term perspective and a genuine sustainability agenda. You work in a friendly, ambitious team in Malmö, with regular collaboration across the Nordics and Finland.

A role with real ownership – you drive your products and see the impact

Part of a supportive, international Nordic team that works well together

A company in active transformation – room to grow and take on more responsibility

Apply today!
Submit your application in english today by uploading your CV, or apply with your LinkedIn URL. We replace the cover letter with screening questions to ensure a fair and efficient application process.
Selection is ongoing and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
In this recruitment, Kiilto is working together with ROI Rekrytering.
For questions, please contact recruitment consultant Lisa Alsterberg at lisa.alsterberg@roirekrytering.se

Company Description

Customs Operations Europe and Africa region in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approximately 47 co-workers. The department includes a dedicated team of Customs Compliance Specialists, alongside operational customs teams, working together to secure well-functioning import and export processes for more than 30 countries in the region. We provide daily support and coordination on customs-related topics, including legal requirements, goods flow, and IT solutions, to secure availability, affordability, and compliance.

Job Description

The Customs Compliance Specialist ensures the efficiency and compliance of the import and export activities in their region and for the countries assigned to their region.
You will:
· In conjunction with the Customs Compliance Manager, establish and maintain Compliance procedures and working methods associated with areas of responsibility
· Lead and coordinate customs classification activities within the assigned area of responsibility, ensuring accurate tariff classification, compliance, and alignment with business needs.
· Manage and support customs compliance programs including post-entry corrections, free trade agreements, bonded solutions and other customs special procedures.
· Lead or support customs compliance reviews, internal assessments and external customs audits.
· Support the establishment and maintenance of customs compliance controls, risk mitigation activities and corrective action plans.
· Build strategic relationships with internal and external business partners, including Customs or other Government agencies
· Work with Finance, Accounting, Transport and Purchasing partners on compliance issues
· Maintain regulatory knowledge and analysis skills as business, regulations or systems change to meet business needs
· Support business expansion and customs-related projects by securing customs compliance readiness and operational implementation.

Qualifications

We are now looking for a new colleague who wants to be a part of our amazing team. We believe you are motivated and inspired by the above assignments. You have plenty of energy and curiosity to learn, and we see that you are a person that is driven and dares to challenge people around you. You are service-minded, with a clear and respectful way of communicating. You enjoy working in a structured way both on your own, within the team and with relevant stakeholders. You have high integrity and the ability to establish relationships at all levels of
the organization, based on trust. You can work with both operational and tactical issues, and you possess facilitation and trainer skills. You can prioritize your work to deliver assignments with high quality. You also can analyze the details while keeping focus on the big picture and follow up on relevant goals and deviations.
You should be:
· Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions
· Fluent in English, both written and verbal
We believe that you have:
· Demonstrated knowledge of Customs Import/Export regulations and compliance management
· Strong knowledge and practical experience in customs valuation, rules of origin, Free Trade Agreements, customs special procedures, compliance controls, and customs audits and investigations, with the ability to identify risks, ensure compliance, and support business objectives.
· Solid knowledge and practical experience in customs classification (tariff classification) and related processes, including the application of customs regulations and maintenance of classification data.
· Experience and knowledge of Change Management
· Good listening skills and strong ability to document and communicate in a clear way
· Ability to build efficiency and compliance into operations while meeting the business needs
· Previous experience in working with external authorities

Additional Information

Please note this position is based in Älmhult, Sweden. For this position we expect that you will work the majority of your time from the office.
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence  requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group. 
If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Sandra Obers, Customs and Compliance Manager for Europe and Africa via sandra.obers1@inter.ikea.com. If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.
Please apply in English before the 26th of November, 2026. 
As we are eager to fill this position, interviews may be conducted before the application deadline. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.
