jobs.occupation: FMT (Trelleborg) is looking for a MANUFACTURING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Dabico FMT designs and builds passenger boarding bridges for airports and seaports around the world. FMT has more than 50 years of experience and is based in Trelleborg, Sweden. Its bridges are in service at more than 85 airports and seaports. FMT is owned by Dabico, a US-based group that supplies airport ground support equipment. We are now ramping up our operations in Sweden, and we’re looking for an engineer who understands design and knows how to turn it into bridges that are right first time and efficient to build.
We welcome candidates with a few years of experience as well as those with more extensive backgrounds. What matters most is your motivation to develop, learn, and gradually take on greater responsibility within the team.
Main responsibilities
Review designs and drawings together with our design engineers for manufacturability, cost and ease of assembly – and propose improvements before they reach the floor.
Translate designs into production: bills of materials, process plans, routings and work instructions.
Define fabrication, welding and assembly methods, fixtures and tolerances for large steel structures and glass-walled tunnels.
Support the production floor day to day – solve technical issues, handle deviations, and feed lessons learned back into the design.
Work with suppliers and other Dabico production sites on make-or-buy decisions, sourcing and component quality.
Ensure our bridges are built to the relevant standards for quality, welding and safety (e.g. EN 1090, ISO 3834, EN 12312-4).
Work closely with our experienced design engineers for guidance and competence development.

The position is full-time, based in Trelleborg. We are a small company where everyone works toward shared goals. You will report directly to Head of Engineering. Occasional business trips are expected a few days per quarter. 
Qualifications and profile
Degree in mechanical or production engineering, or similar.
Around 2–3 years or more of experience in manufacturing or production engineering, preferably with welded steel structures or large mechanical assemblies.
A solid understanding of mechanical design – you read drawings critically, understand tolerances and can see how a design will be built.
·Experience with 3D CAD and drawings, and with BOMs and ERP systems.
Knowledge of welding and fabrication methods; experience of lean or continuous improvement is a plus.
Fluency in English and good proficiency in Swedish.
Hands-on and comfortable spending time on the production floor as well as at the desk.
Curious, analytical, and solution oriented.
Ambition to grow into the role and take on more responsibility, and a team player who wants to be part of a skilled and technology-driven organisation.

Contact and application
In this recruitment process, we co-operate with the recruitment company ComCube. If you are interested and match the profile, please apply through the link with a cover letter and a CV in English where you describe your experience and expertise in the areas outlined above. Please answer the following questions in your cover letter:
Why are you interested in the position as Manufacturing Engineer at FMT?
What do you think you can contribute as Manufacturing Engineer at FMT?

If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process or the position, you are very welcome to contact our consultants in this process: Helena Heijmink, +46 70 554 03 42, helena.heijmink@comcube.se, or Helena Fransson, +46 70 554 05 04. This is an ongoing selection, so please apply as soon as possible. We can only accept applications through the link. 
FMT is a privately owned company with more than 50 years of experience in design, manufacturing and delivery of innovative passenger handling and operational support systems for airports and seaports worldwide. All research & development, manufacturing and the direction of the sales & marketing take place at FMT´s headquarters located in Trelleborg, Sweden. FMT works closely with partners around the world. FMT´s range of products includes a wide variety of Passenger Boarding Bridge Systems, specifically designed to meet the particular needs and requirements of an airport or seaport and after-sales support. FMT´s expertise lies in creating tailor-made solutions to improve safe, flexible and fast turnarounds for airports and seaports with high passenger flows.
For more information, please visit https://www.fmt.se/

jobs.occupation: Senior Accounting Specialist to Business Sweden
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute with your accounting expertise to a unique international organization? Business Sweden is now recruiting an Senior Accounting Specialist with a key role within the finance function. You will work in an international environment that helps Swedish companies grow global sales and international companies invest and expand in Sweden.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced accounting specialist with a strong business perspective and expertise in group accounting, tax, and VAT. The role provides expert support to the organization on accounting matters.
You will have a central role in the month-end and year-end closing and reporting processes, while also contributing to the development and quality assurance of accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls.
The role is based at Business Sweden’s Headquarters, located in the World Trade Center in Stockholm. You report to the Head of Global Finance Operations and are part of the Global Finance Operations team.
Key responsibilities

Monthly and annual closings, with overall responsibility for group accounting

Ensure that accounting and reporting are carried out in accordance with the applicable K3 accounting framework and other external accounting requirements

Act as the organization’s tax and VAT specialist, providing advice to the business on complex matters and overseeing VAT reporting, VAT reconciliations, and tax-related reporting, including corporate income tax returns

Participate in the establishment of legal entities and other legal changes

Financial responsibility for international offices

Participate in the planning, preparation, and quality assurance of annual reports

Participate in internal and external audits

Contribute to the development, standardization, and improvement of existing ways of working

Qualifications

Degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a related field

Several years of experience in qualified accounting, including financial closing, group consolidation, annual reports, and audits

Experience working in an international environment

Very good knowledge of the K3 accounting framework

Very good knowledge of Swedish and international tax legislation and VAT regulations

Good understanding of internal controls and financial reporting

Very good knowledge of Excel and business systems/ERP

High level of proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

Personal qualities

Analytical, high attention to detail and a strong focus on quality

Independent, structured, and able to take ownership

Ability to translate regulations and theory into practical solutions

Strong collaboration and communication skills

Proactive and driven in improvement and development initiatives

Pragmatic team player with a hands-on approach and a willingness to contribute where needed

High level of integrity and sound professional judgment

Key success factors
To succeed in this role, you need to combine deep expertise in accounting, tax, and VAT with a business-oriented mindset. You are proactive, take ownership of issues, and ensure that the organization’s accounting is of high quality and compliant with current regulations.
Application
For this recruitment process, Business Sweden collaborates with Capega and the recruitment consultant Ida-Maria Rundén. Please submit your CV and cover letter in English no later than November 8. Your application will be treated confidentially. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and the position may be filled before the final application deadline.
Diversity powering global growth
At Business Sweden we value and encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We strive for a workplace where all colleagues can explore their full potential and contribute with their unique experiences. By embracing a wide range perspective, we can better drive sustainable growth and customer-centric excellence.
About Business Sweden
Business Sweden helps Swedish companies grow global sales and international companies invest and expand in Sweden. With a unique mandate from the Swedish government and the business sector, we offer strategic advice and practical support in more than 40 markets worldwide.
Our mission is to help lay the foundation for sustainable, inclusive, and digital growth – in Sweden and around the world. We do this by providing startups, small- and medium sized companies and multinationals with tailored services, coupled with access to key stakeholders in the public and private spheres.
We help our clients build relationships, accelerate time-to-market, and comply with local standards and regulations. Visit business-sweden.com for more information.

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
We are looking for a Legal Counsel to join the Tech Legal team at our Head Office in Stockholm.   
This role is ideal for someone with a genuine interest in working with tech contracts and negotiations in the world of retail and fashion. You will provide advice on a wide range of legal matters, primarily in the tech area, while supporting the business in managing opportunities and risks from a global perspective. H&M Group is a large and exciting organization with a great culture, and you will be working with dedicated and talented colleagues. 
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO  
 
As Legal Counsel in the Tech Legal team, you will belong to a team within the Group Legal function, a core part of the H&M Group. Tech Legal currently consists of 6 people and provides legal, negotiation and procurement support to the H&M Group. You will support and participate in negotiations and advise on H&M Group’s global tech contracts, as well as working with AI, tech law and data privacy matters, among other areas. 
In the role as Legal Counsel, you will:  
Provide commercial, contractual and negotiation expertise in the tech and IT area across H&M Group functions, brands, regions and markets, including risk identification and mitigation. 
Draft, review and interpret legal documents. 
Provide advice and supporting documentation during all phases of a business relationship, from initial contact through to the closure of agreements, including legal support during the operational phase and assistance through to the end of the relationship. 
Take an active part in decision-making related to legal and commercial matters, to ensure that agreements enable the best possible business outcome. 
Contribute to internal knowledge development and transfer within the H&M Group, including creating and presenting processes, templates, toolkits and best practices. 
Collaborate with all other teams at H&M Group Legal, to provide comprehensive legal support to the H&M Group. 
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders across the organization, acting as a trusted legal advisor to the business. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking a person with... 
A university law degree 
At least 3 years' work experience involving tech-related commercial contracts, with a company or law firm in an international setting  
Negotiation experience from commercial agreements with vendors or customers of all sizes 
Experience in contract law, including drafting commerical agreements 
Understanding of basic financial aspects of a business deal and the ability to assess opportunities and risks related thereto 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills (professional English required)  
Familiarity with legal frameworks, such as within data privace and AI, is considered a merit  
Experience working in cross-functional and international teams  

And a person who is... 
An excellent collaborator who will pitch in where needed, with a positive attitude and an ability to find solutions where others don’t. 
Able to explain and advise on complex legal matters to beginners as well as to seasoned professionals. 
Enjoy working independently, while also having a supportive team of colleagues on hand when you need it. 
Able to structure and prioritize your work efficiently. 
Capable of maintaining a strong sense of integrity and rational thinking, while sustaining a service-minded and friendly approach. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office on Sveavägen in Stockholm. This role reports directly to the Manager of Tech Legal. 
If you feel that your experience, skills and personality are right for this role, please submit your application, including a CV and cover letter in English. Any background in the legal areas referenced in the introduction should be highlighted in your application, as these are of particular interest. We look forward to hearing from you! 
WHO WE ARE  
 
H&M Group is a family of brands; H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. At H&M Group, our people are the driving force behind our commitment to creating meaningful growth and more sustainable lifestyles. Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Österåker är en modern, tvåspråkig F–9-skola i Åkersberga som öppnade sina dörrar 2024. Vi är en internationell, dynamisk och varm arbetsplats med stark teamkänsla och ett stort fokus på elevernas trygghet, utveckling och välmående.

Vi söker nu en socialpedagog på 100 % som vill vara en viktig del av skolans trygghets- och elevstödjande arbete.

Som socialpedagog hos oss blir du en närvarande och trygg vuxen för våra elever, med ett särskilt fokus på ungdomar i årskurs 7–9. Du arbetar relationsskapande och förebyggande och bidrar aktivt till att skapa en trygg, inkluderande och positiv skolmiljö där eleverna ges möjlighet att lyckas både socialt och i sitt skolarbete.Om tjänsten

I din roll som socialpedagog finns du nära eleverna under skoldagen. Du arbetar aktivt med att bygga förtroendefulla relationer och skapa en miljö där elever känner sig sedda, lyssnade på och respekterade.

Du kommer bland annat att:

- vara en trygg och tillgänglig vuxen som elever kan vända sig till
- arbeta relationsskapande och förebyggande med elevernas sociala utveckling
- fånga upp elever som behöver extra stöd, motivation eller en trygg vuxenkontakt
- arbeta för ökad trivsel, trygghet, gemenskap och skolnärvaro
- stötta elever i sociala situationer och vid konflikter
- bidra till att förebygga kränkningar, utanförskap och problematisk skolfrånvaro
- ha motiverande och stöttande samtal med elever
- samarbeta med lärare, elevhälsa och övrig personal kring elevernas behov
- bidra med ett socialpedagogiskt perspektiv i skolans elevhälsoarbete
- vara delaktig i skolans trygghetsarbete och olika förebyggande insatser
- skapa aktiviteter och sammanhang som främjar gemenskap och inkludering.

Som socialpedagog behöver du kunna möta elever med olika behov och förutsättningar. Du är lyhörd och nyfiken och har förmågan att skapa relationer även med elever som kan ha svårt att hitta sin plats i skolan.

Du ser möjligheter snarare än begränsningar och arbetar lösningsfokuserat med elevernas bästa i centrum.Vi söker dig som

- har utbildning som socialpedagog eller annan relevant utbildning
- har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomars sociala utveckling och välmående
- tycker om att arbeta nära ungdomar och bygga långsiktiga förtroendefulla relationer
- är trygg, stabil och tydlig i din vuxenroll
- har ett respektfullt och professionellt bemötande
- är lyhörd och har förmåga att se bakom ett beteende och förstå elevens behov
- är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med både elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
- är initiativtagande, lösningsfokuserad och flexibel
- kan hantera utmanande situationer på ett lugnt och professionellt sätt
- har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska – detta är ett krav.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom skola, elevhälsa, ungdomsverksamhet, socialt arbete eller annan verksamhet där du arbetat med barn och ungdomar.Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra skillnad

Som socialpedagog på IES Österåker får du en viktig roll i skolans arbete med trygghet, gemenskap och elevhälsa. Du blir en betydelsefull vuxen i elevernas vardag och får möjlighet att bygga relationer som kan göra stor skillnad för den enskilda eleven.

Du arbetar tillsammans med engagerade kollegor i en internationell och dynamisk skolmiljö där vi tror på samarbete, tydlighet och att alla elever ska ges möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar.Låter detta som ett arbete för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan med CV och ett kort personligt brev så snart som möjligt.Rekrytering sker löpande.

Observera att utdrag ur belastningsregistret krävs enligt lag före anställning inom skola.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Build something monumental for Healthcare!
At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tandem is scaling fast – and so is the volume and complexity of what we bring to market. We're building our PMM function to match that ambition, and this role is a core part of that build.
You'll own the commercial narrative layer of our go-to-market: how we position ourselves in the market, how we enable sales to win, and how we turn clinical evidence and product data into stories that resonate with healthcare buyers and decision-makers. This is not a launch execution role – it is the role that makes sure the market understands what Tandem is, why it matters, and why it wins."
If you're someone who thinks in outcomes, communicates with conviction, and knows how to make complex things feel simple – this role is for you.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Define and maintain Tandem's differentiated positioning across segments, verticals, and geographies – from first principles, not a competitor's playbook
Build and own the sales enablement library that lets sales tell the story independently – pitch decks, demo narratives, one-pagers, talk tracks, and competitive battlecards that are actually used
Develop a deep, evolving view of the healthcare AI landscape – incumbents, point solutions, and the clinical status quo – and turn it into sharp competitive positioning
Be the voice of the market internally – bring buyer perspective, competitor moves, and field objections to product and leadership
Partner with Growth and Design to drive conversion across web, campaigns, and lifecycle touchpoints
Own product storytelling across key growth surfaces, continuously optimising for clarity, differentiation, and conversion on product-related pages
Synthesize customer conversations, win/loss analysis, usage data, and competitive intel into positioning and product decisions
Track content and enablement contribution to pipeline – not output volume, but actual deal influence

WHAT YOU BRING
3–5 years of marketing experience in a B2B environment, with a strong track record in positioning, sales enablement, or competitive intelligence
A strong communicator who doesn't just execute – you sell ideas internally, bring stakeholders along, and make complex decisions land clearly across the business
Commercial instinct – you understand the business, not just the marketing, and know how to make trade-offs that actually move the needle
Stakeholder management skills – you're comfortable navigating product, sales, design, and leadership simultaneously and making progress without full authority
Fluent in English – you communicate clearly and confidently in spoken and written English
Technically curious – you don't need to write code, but you ask the right questions to understand why we built X instead of Y, and what that means for how we go to market
Healthcare experience is not required – what matters is the ability to get up to speed fast and communicate with credibility in a complex, regulated space

LOCATION
We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based full time on-site at our HQ in the heart of Stockholm, where you'll collaborate, connect, and help build our culture.
Culture at Tandem
At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Sinch is looking for a forward-thinking Senior Product Designer to drive the next generation of our design system infrastructure. Rather than focusing solely on maintaining static components, you will take a central role in redefining how our visual language, layout principles, and patterns operate in an AI-assisted product development lifecycle. Your mission is to define the visual standards, semantic tokens, and clear system guidelines (.md files) that allow both human designers and AI-agents to generate cohesive, high-quality, and on-brand UI across multiple product suites. This is a unique opportunity for a system-level designer who wants to bridge the gap between creative visual craft and generative AI.
Drive the vision and architecture for an AI-ready design system, creating a framework of semantic rules and patterns optimized for prompt-based UI generation.
Collaborate closely with our central Brand team to ensure Sinch's brands are accurately and consistently represented in our digital product patterns and component libraries.
Translate our design patterns into clear, structured instructions and guidelines (.md files) that allow engineering teams and AI-agents to reliably generate on-brand interfaces.
Collaborate closely with design leadership and stakeholders to establish the long-term roadmap for our global design system across multiple Sinch products.
Work with your fellow product and engineering partners to build, test, and ship scalable design system tooling. 
Partner with and support product teams globally, ensuring they have the tools, templates, and guidance to design and develop quickly using the system.
Ensure high standards of accessibility (WCAG), usability, and visual quality are deeply baked into the underlying system architecture, so they are automatically inherited during UI generation.
Experiment with and pioneer new workflows that integrate AI-assisted design and prototyping tools directly into our daily design system operations.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant experience as a Design Systems Designer or Senior Product Designer working on complex, multi-product design systems at scale.
Deep understanding of design system architecture, including advanced token strategies, component lifecycles, and keeping design patterns aligned with code.
Experience in generative AI frameworks, prompting structures, structured markdown (.md files), and how LLMs interpret design semantics and visual rules. 
A strong strategic and visionary mindset, with a proven history of defining direction and driving alignment with design leaders, product managers, and engineering stakeholders.
Excellent collaboration and advocacy skills, comfortable presenting to and educating diverse product teams on new workflows and design system standards.
Outstanding craft and execution skills, with a portfolio showing systematic thinking, clear design documentation, and a strong eye for visual consistency and modern UI patterns.
Strong understanding of how design translates to code (HTML/CSS, React, Tokens), as you do not need to be a production engineer, but you should easily speak the same language as developers.
Comfort conducting user research and discovery as part of a product trio to understand how internal teams use the design system and where friction exists.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Stockholm as the preferred location and Malmö as an alternative. You’ll report to the Director, Product Design. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
Why this role matters
As Sinch scales, keeping our products coherent across multiple platforms requires a fundamentally new approach to design systems. By designing the infrastructure for AI-assisted workflows, you will enable teams to ship features faster while keeping our interfaces accessible and on-brand. Your work will directly shape how every product team at Sinch designs and builds, transforming our design system from a static reference library into an active engine for AI-assisted, high-quality product development.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Sinch Build is looking for a versatile Senior Product Designer who enjoys working across different parts of a complex platform. In this role, your focus will be on hands-on design, taking on different areas of the Sinch Build portal as priorities evolve.
Our portal serves a diverse audience, so your design thinking must cater to multiple user types, sometimes within the same interface. This position is for an active practitioner who can design intuitive interfaces for humans while remaining mindful of how automated systems and conversational chat interfaces interact with that same content. You should be quick to learn new technical domains, comfortable collaborating with different engineering teams, and dedicated to maintaining a high standard of usability across the entire portal.
Own the entire experience by partnering with Product Managers and Engineers to run discovery, validate assumptions, and turn platform design capabilities into clear user experiences with measurable impact. 
Deliver hands-on, end-to-end designs including user flows and interactive prototypes for various platform domains based on current team needs.
Design for multiple user types in one interface, ensuring experiences are equally intuitive.
Account for agentic user experiences by structuring content and interfaces so that they are easily navigable and consumable by both human users and AI-agents.
Flexibly adapt to different product areas, transition comfortably between conversational/chat UIs, data visualization dashboards, developer settings, billing flows, and documentation surfaces. 
Utilize and contribute back to our shared design system, ensuring the components and patterns you design remain consistent and accessible across all surfaces you work on.
Leverage modern design tools and AI-assisted engineering environments to quickly explore ideas, iterate on feedback, and accelerate your design-to-development workflow.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant experience as a hands-on Product Designer working on complex SaaS, platform, or developer-focused products.
Experience designing for multiple user types, with a proven ability to balance the needs of highly technical users alongside non-technical users.
High adaptability and comfort with variety, with a proven ability to quickly learn new product domains and jump into ongoing projects with minimal friction.
Strong craft and execution skills, with a portfolio showing clean UI design, thoughtful interaction patterns, and clear user flows.
Fluency with modern design workflows, including comfort utilizing AI-assisted development environments to speed up execution, prototyping, and engineering handoffs.
Excellent collaboration skills and a history of working daily with Product Managers and Engineering teams.
Comfort with user research and product discovery as part of a product trio is a strong plus, helping you collaboratively validate assumptions, run tests, and gather insights.
Interest or experience in agentic workflows, conversational UI, or designing data structures and interfaces that accommodate AI consumption is also a plus.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Stockholm as the preferred location and Malmö as an alternative. You’ll report to the Director, Product Design. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
Why this role matters
Our platform teams tackle a wide array of technical and business-facing challenges, and the design demand naturally shifts from one domain to another. Having a flexible, highly capable Senior Designer who can move where the impact is greatest allows us to stay agile. Your ability to jump in, quickly understand a problem space, and ship clean, accessible designs, ensures that the experience is seamless and cohesive.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for creating awesome character design concepts, magical environment concepts and whatever is needed to enhance game experience? Are you excited about crafting vibrant visuals for mobile games that captivate millions of players?
As a Concept Artist at Snowprint, you’ll have a broad role with plenty of room to influence the visual direction of our new game project. You’ll mainly work on character and outfit concepts, but also contribute to props, items, environments, key art, and whatever else is needed to bring the game’s visual world together.
You’ll be part of a small team where your ideas and perspective matter. You’ll work closely with the Art Director, other artists, designers, and developers, with the freedom to take ownership of your work and find solutions rather than simply working from a list of tasks.
At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and a shared passion for making great games are key to creating a good place to work and great games.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll primarily create concepts for characters and their outfits, developing ideas that can be translated into 3D models and eventually brought into the game. You’ll work from early ideas through to more detailed concepts and turnarounds, making sure your designs communicate the character clearly and give the 3D team what they need to take them further.
You’ll also create key art and title screens, as well as concepts for props, items, environments, and other visual elements when needed. The role gives you the opportunity to work across different types of concept art and contribute to the overall visual quality of the game.
You’ll work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the art team, sharing work early, discussing ideas, and responding to feedback throughout the process. You’ll be encouraged to explore different approaches, adapt your style to the needs of the game, and keep moving rather than over-polishing before getting feedback.
Is this you?
You’re an experienced Concept Artist with professional experience working on at least one released game. Experience from a stylized, fantasy, or high-fidelity game is particularly relevant.

You have a strong understanding of character design, including anatomy, proportions, clothing, poses, lighting, composition, mood, and surfaces. You know how to make designs feel visually interesting while still having a clear function and purpose.

You understand the path from concept to 3D. You know how to create clear character turnarounds and other concepts that give 3D artists what they need to build and implement the asset.

You’re adaptable and comfortable working within an established art direction. You can adjust your style to what the game needs and are comfortable working across characters, props, environments, and key art.

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio
Strong character / creature appeal and design fundamentals

Dynamic / interesting character presentation

Work samples showing confidence in human and animal anatomy

A strong understanding of light and material behaviour

Clear character sheets for 3D artists

Where you’ll work
Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.
We’re unable to support relocation for this position, so you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden.
About Snowprint Studios
Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment, while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.
Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.
For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.
At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.
Good to know
We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

Mälardalens Arkitektur är ett konsultföretag som stöttar bygg- och industriprojekt med teknisk och miljömässig expertis. Vi arbetar nära långvariga kunder inom industriell tillverkning och hjälper dem att möta ökande krav på klimatredovisning, materialeffektivitet och hållbart byggande. Läs mer på vår webbplats: https://malardalensarkitektur.se/sv/.
Vi har ett långvarigt samarbete med ett stort företag, en ledande tillverkare av separatorfilm för litiumjonbatterier. Vår kund bygger upp sin europeiska produktionsbas i Eskilstuna, där de två första fabrikerna redan är under uppförande. Inför ett nytt uppdrag för vår kund med start 2027 utökar vi vårt team med en miljöingenjör / LCA-analytiker.

Rollen
Du kommer att leda livscykelanalyser och miljöanalyser för bygg- och industrianläggningsprojekt och arbeta direkt med våra kunders projekt- och hållbarhetsteam. Rollen kombinerar teknisk analys med rådgivning, och du hjälper kunderna att förstå miljöpåverkan av sina material- och utformningsval.
Arbetsuppgifter
Genomföra livscykelanalyser enligt ISO 14040/14044 och SS-EN 15978 för byggnader och industrianläggningar
Upprätta klimatdeklarationer och stötta arbete med miljöcertifiering (t.ex. Miljöbyggnad, BREEAM)
Utvärdera och tolka EPD:er och materialdata samt ge råd om materialalternativ med lägre miljöpåverkan
Samla in och strukturera miljödata från leverantörer, entreprenörer och produktionsprocesser
Stötta kunder med beräkningar av klimatavtryck och hållbarhetsrapportering, inklusive krav kopplade till CSRD
Skriva tydliga tekniska rapporter och presentera resultat för kunder och projektgrupper

Kvalifikationer
Civilingenjörsexamen/masterexamen eller högre inom materialvetenskap, miljöteknik, kemiteknik eller närliggande område
God förståelse för material, deras produktionsprocesser och miljöpåverkan
Erfarenhet av LCA-metodik och minst ett LCA-verktyg (t.ex. SimaPro, Sphera/GaBi, openLCA eller One Click LCA)
Stark analytisk förmåga och förmåga att kommunicera tekniska resultat till icke-specialister
Flytande engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande
Erfarenhet av industriella eller batterirelaterade material
Kunskap om svenska regler för klimatdeklaration av byggnader
Kunskaper i mandarin

English:
Environmental Engineer / LCA Analyst MÄLARDALENS ARKITEKTUR – Eskilstuna
About us Mälardalens Arkitektur is a consultancy that supports construction and industrial projects with technical and environmental expertise. We work closely with long-standing clients in industrial manufacturing, helping them meet growing demands on climate reporting, material efficiency and sustainable construction. Please visit our homepage for more info: https://malardalensarkitektur.se/sv/.
We have a long-standing collaboration with our client,  a leading manufacturer of separator film for lithium-ion batteries. Our client is building its European production base in Eskilstuna, with its first two factories there already under construction. Ahead of a new assignment for our client starting in 2027, we are expanding our team with an Environmental Engineer / LCA Analyst.
The role You will lead life cycle assessments and environmental analyses for construction and industrial facility projects, working directly with our clients' project and sustainability teams. The role combines technical analysis with advisory work, and you will help clients understand the environmental impact of their material and design choices.
Responsibilities
· Perform life cycle assessments according to ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15978 for buildings and industrial facilities
· Prepare climate declarations (klimatdeklarationer) and support environmental certification work (e.g. Miljöbyggnad, BREEAM)
· Evaluate and interpret EPDs and material data, and advise on lower-impact material alternatives
· Collect and structure environmental data from suppliers, contractors and production processes
· Support clients with carbon footprint calculations and sustainability reporting, including CSRD-related requirements
· Write clear technical reports and present results to clients and project teams
Qualifications
· Master's degree or higher in materials science, environmental engineering, chemical engineering or a related field
· Solid understanding of materials, their production processes and environmental impacts
· Experience with LCA methodology and at least one LCA tool (e.g. SimaPro, Sphera/GaBi, openLCA or One Click LCA)
· Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate technical results to non-specialists
· Fluent in English, spoken and written
Meritorious
· Experience with industrial or battery-related materials
· Knowledge of Swedish regulations on climate declarations for buildings
· Mandarin language skills
Employment terms
· Type: Permanent position (tillsvidareanställning), full-time
· Start: By agreement
· Location: Eskilstuna, with travel to client sites as needed
· Salary: Individual salary according to agreement
How to apply Send your CV and a short cover letter to info@malardalensarkitektur.se no later than 15th Jan, 2027. Selection is ongoing, so feel free to apply early

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Behörig speciallärare till F–3 sökes!

Är du en behörig och erfaren speciallärare som kan inspirera och stödja våra elever på IES Kista? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Kista öppnade 2015 och har idag omkring 640 elever från F till årskurs 9. Vi är övertygade om att vårt tydliga etos och våra engagerade och närvarande ledare bidrar till en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare möjlighet att fokusera på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör – alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella Engelska Skolan arbetar vi som ett team och strävar åt samma håll. För att trivas hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande samt gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi vill att varje elev ska känna sig trygg och trivas i en stimulerande lärmiljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga.

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker en kvalificerad och erfaren speciallärare som ska arbeta specifikt med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3. Du har ett positivt förhållningssätt och en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga att utvecklas.

Tillsammans med klasslärare, fritidsassistenter, specialpedagog och övrig personal i elevhälsoteamet arbetar du för att skapa en trygg, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö. Du bidrar med speciallärare kompetens och stöttar elevernas kunskapsmässiga och sociala utveckling.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

- planera, genomföra och följa upp riktade stödinsatser för elever i F–3
- undervisa enskilda elever och elever i mindre grupper
- stödja elever i klassrummet vid behovs
- arbeta förebyggande och främjande tillsammans med klasslärare och elevhälsoteamet
- handleda lärare och samarbeta med övrig pedagogisk personal
- arbeta med ett särskilt fokus på språk-, läs-, skriv- och matematikutveckling.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100 procent, med tillträde så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Provanställning tillämpas under de första sex månaderna.Vem är du?

Det är ett krav att du har:

- svensk lärarexamen och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i F–3
- speciallärarexamen eller specialpedagogexamen
- dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3.

Du har god pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att omsätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du är trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap och i mötet med eleverna. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Som en närvarande och reflekterande pedagog utmanar och stimulerar du eleverna i deras utveckling.

Du ser samarbete som en viktig framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen. Du kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Du har erfarenhet av pedagogisk dokumentation och av att upprätta och följa upp åtgärdsprogram. Du har goda kunskaper om NPF och tydliggörande pedagogik samt erfarenhet av positivt beteendestöd och lågaffektivt bemötande.

Du är positiv, lösningsfokuserad och samarbetsvillig samt beredd att ingå i ett internationellt team.

I din roll undervisar du på svenska och/eller engelska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personalen. Du behöver därför behärska både svenska och engelska väl, i tal och skrift.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se:https://engelska.se/our-schools/kista/about-our-school/

Intervjuer genomförs löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret och giltig ID-handling krävs.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

What will you do?
As a AI/ML Engineer at Rebtel you will define how AI is done at Rebtel. What tooling we standardise on, how we evaluate models we put in front of real users, what "good" looks like for our prompts and our pipelines. AI is going from a side project to the core of how Rebtel operates and what we ship to our users. We're hiring the second engineer on our ML/AI subteam to help build it classical ML for the business, LLM-powered systems for the product, and a clear production mindset on both.
You'll sit inside the Data team, report to our Head of Data, and partner with one other ML/AI engineer to shape this capability from the ground up.
Areas of ownership: You'll own work across two complementary tracks, and you'll ship in both.
Classical ML, in production, for operational leverage

Risk and fraud models across payments, top-ups, and account behaviour

Churn prediction and retention modelling on a user base of a million-plus

Forecasting, pricing, segmentation, and the next batch of operational problems we haven't tackled yet

Owning models end-to-end scoping with stakeholders, building, deploying, monitoring, retraining

LLMs and AI agents, from internal automation to in-product features

Start with our customer support agents and automations: RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, tool-use, evaluation harnesses

Move LLM capability into the product as user-facing features

Help guide the company on where AI actually creates leverage, what to build, what to buy, what to ignore and turn the good ideas into shipped systems

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

4+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python, with real production ownership not just notebooks

Strong fundamentals in classical ML: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and the unglamorous parts of keeping a model healthy in prod

A genuine production mindset: monitoring, retraining, eval harnesses, CI/CD for models, and the instinct to debug when something drifts at 2am

Comfort working the whole loop: stakeholder scoping → data → model → deployment → measurement → iteration

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to translate between business problems and ML ones

Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents

Built RAG systems, agentic workflows, or LLM-backed products that real users (or real internal teams) actually used

Comfortable with vector databases, embeddings, prompt evaluation, and measuring LLM systems with something more rigorous than vibes

Obsession with staying up-to-date on developments in the AI space 

Experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), containers, and a modern data stack

Experience in MLOps tooling: MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes and feature stores is a plus

Background in fintech, payments, telecom, or other regulated / operational domains is a plus

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

At the global market leader in energy technology, you contribute to ensuring a stable energy supply for the future. With our intelligent digital and analog solutions, you help shape the energy transition. As part of a global team of 5,900 dedicated colleagues, you experience the unique sense of togetherness that defines our family-owned group of companies.
 Reinhausen – where Power meets Passion
What awaits you: 
You manage customer inquiries and orders throughout the entire service and spare parts order process, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
You identify the required spare parts and prepare quotations and cost calculations based on technical specifications and customer needs.
You review and process customer orders, ensuring alignment with agreed prices, terms and conditions.
You coordinate with customers and internal departments to ensure smooth order processing, timely deliveries and effective communication.
You manage order documentation, follow up on changes and additional costs, and prepare completed orders for invoicing.
You contribute to continuous improvements in processes, system usage and data quality to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.

What you bring to the table:
You have a post-secondary technical or vocational education, or equivalent relevant work experience.
You have 2–3 years of experience in service order management, technical sales support or a similar role.
You have technical understanding and the ability to identify spare parts, interpret technical documentation and prepare accurate quotations.
You have experience working with ERP or order management systems, preferably SAP, and are confident using Microsoft Office.
You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken. Swedish and other Nordic languages are an advantage.
You are detail-oriented, customer-focused and structured, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
